borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Conversion of the double garage into habitable accommodation and a habitable room including new front entrance for 74A and 74B Sherwood Gardens
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Existing and Proposed Plans - drawing no. N.A/74a&amp;bSG/101 Issue A -&nbsp; dated 04/12/2025</li><li>Existing and Proposed Plans - drawing no. N.A/74a&amp;bSG/110&nbsp;&nbsp;- dated 04/12/2025</li><li>Design and Access Statement&nbsp; -dated 15-12-2025</li><li>Flood map for planning - dated 11 December 2025</li><li>Fire Safety Statement - dated 09-12-2025</li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.

<p>The garage conversions may only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellings. As such, it shall not be used for purposes conflicting with the use of the property as a single dwellinghouse, and in particular they shall not be used as a separate unit(s) of accommodation.</p>
